description.value:
Frequency once per turn

Trigger You raise a single Afflicted.

Raising one Afflicted becomes a free action instead of costing its usual action. This applies to a single Afflicted only — raising more than one in the same casting or effect costs the usual action for all of them. The Miasma cost, if any, is unchanged.

cinderfall.incomplete: No ItemAlteration property (checked the full corrected-facts property list: frequency-max/frequency-per adjust how often an item can be used, not what it costs to use) or any other rule element changes an action's own action-cost. Miasma is this class's focus-pool-that-doesn't-refill-on-rest resource. No SpecialResource rule element exists for it anywhere in the corpus: the class card itself (classes.plaguesworn.json:49) ships system.rules: [], and grep -rl "SpecialResource" site/data/cards/feats/class/plaguesworn/ site/data/cards/classes/classes.plaguesworn.json returns zero hits. Any clause that costs, refills, or banks Miasma is unbuildable via the renew:false mechanism -- that mechanism simply isn't wired up for this class. Afflicted is this class's minion subsystem: a raise-cap, a collapse timer, and (at level 18) a shared cross-actor Resonance pool. pf2e's schema has no generic "max controlled minions" field, no "minion lifespan" field, and no mechanism for one actor's rule element to modify a different actor's stats on an ongoing basis. ("Raising an Afflicted" itself is unbuilt -- P-SUMMON -- so the action this card would speed up doesn't exist either.)
